name: Living Earth
description: Global biomass distribution by taxonomic/domain group (Bar-On, Phillips & Milo, PNAS 2018). Values in Gt C, approximate.

name: Plants
description: Land plants; overwhelmingly the largest biomass pool on Earth, mostly cellulose in vascular tissue.

name: Bacteria
description: Includes both terrestrial (mostly deep subsurface) and marine bacteria.

name: Fungi
description: Includes free-living and symbiotic fungi in soil and marine environments.

name: Archaea
description: Largely deep subsurface communities; taxonomically distinct from Bacteria.

name: Protists
description: Single-celled eukaryotes including algae and other microbial eukaryotes.

name: Animals
description: Sum of animal subgroup biomass below.

name: Arthropods
description: Mostly marine arthropods (e.g. copepods, krill); largest animal subgroup by biomass.

name: Livestock
description: Domesticated mammals raised by humans (cattle, pigs, etc.).

name: Nematodes
description: Roundworms; extremely numerous but small individual mass.
